criteria.label: Germline constraint
criteria.reason: not evaluable for an extension: unique region was never coding
criteria.interpretation_hint: Germline TOLERANCE. For an EXTENSION both inputs are uninterpretable about protein constraint: the gnomAD ratio measures variation in never-coding nucleotides, and the ESM-C score is out of distribution. Zero constrained positions in the unique region is the NORM for extensions, not a negative finding. Never present the two as conflicting.

criteria.label: Disease variant density
criteria.interpretation_hint: DISEASE density. A ratio at or above 1 means disease variants concentrate in the unique region.

terse: reasoning: Only one of the two variant signals can speak to this extension, and it reports nothing: no disease variants fall in the added 23 aa against 52 in the canonical body the isoform retains. That is a real, if modest, negative — 69 nt is a small target, so absence there is weak evidence rather than none. The germline signals cannot temper or corroborate it, because the added region was never coding: the gnomAD ratio of 0.88 is measuring UTR variation and the ESM-C score is flagged out of distribution. Reading either as constraint would import a conclusion the measurement cannot support.
